query_deduplication: Before any stage allocation, keep exactly one base case for each normalized query over all five sources. Winner is minimum SHA256(source_id || base_item_id). This is source/model independent.
sgd_capacity_reservoir: For feasibility computation only, retain at most 6000 normalized-query-unique SGD carry-over bases per D3/D4/D5, ordered by SHA256('sgd-feasibility-reservoir' || domain || base_item_id). This is a conservative undercount relative to the full source.
n9_capacity_reservoir: Evaluate lexical-decoy eligibility only within at most 1600 deterministic bases per domain ordered by SHA256('n9-feasibility-reservoir' || domain || source || base_item_id). Undiscovered full-corpus N9 candidates remain ineligible, so this can only undercount N9 capacity.

transport_variants.edge_order: For variant v, source-domain transport edges are ordered by SHA256('transport' || stage || v || source || domain). Source/sink capacities and domain/source totals never change.
transport_variants.selection: Use the first variant whose transport flow saturates the stage and whose resulting source-domain cell quotas admit a full family b-matching. If none of 32 variants succeeds, stage feasibility FAILS.

family_b_matching.cell_case_order_ev_b: ascending stress_count, then SHA256('family' || stage || base_item_id)
family_b_matching.cell_case_order_ev_c: descending stress_count, then SHA256('family' || stage || base_item_id)

removal_after_stage: Selected base IDs and their normalized queries are removed ephemerally before the next stage. Only an aggregate SHA256 digest of selected IDs may be persisted before formal freeze.
no_evidence_assignment: After stage selection, N10-primary cases are no-evidence; remaining quota is filled by SHA256('no-evidence' || stage || base_item_id) among non-N10 selected cases. No query text is changed.
stress_postcheck: Apply allocation-policy-v4 EV-C stress rule. A failed required >=0.01 EV-C-vs-EV-B delta is a pre-formal evaluation-design blocker; it does not authorize threshold/source/family/domain changes after Candidate-v13 execution.
